meta.title: 3 MUST-VISIT Spots in Da Nang 🇻🇳 | Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra Marina & Marble Mountains in ONE DAY!
meta.description:
We started our trip at the beautiful Linh Ung Pagoda, home to the iconic Lady Buddha overlooking Da Nang. From there, we visited the picturesque Son Tra Marina, one of the most Instagram-worthy spots in the city, before ending our day exploring the incredible caves, temples, and viewpoints of Marble Mountains.

If you're planning a trip to Da Nang, these places are definitely worth adding to your itinerary!

📍 Places visited:
• Linh Ung Pagoda / Lady Buddha
• Son Tra Marina
• Marble Mountains
